iPhone 16 

Hello Apple Intelligence 

Take a closer look.

Apple Intelligence

iPhone 16 is built for Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data — not even Apple.

Explore new tools that help you write, focus, and communicate.

Writing Tools can summarise a portion of your content with a tap and edit and rewrite portions until the tone and words are appropriate. Almost anywhere you write, even third-party programs, you can find them.

To collect audio recordings and transcripts, press the record button in the Notes or Phone app. Apple Intelligence summarises your transcripts so you can quickly review the most crucial information.

Time-sensitive communications, such as an invitation with a deadline today or a check-in reminder for your travel this afternoon, are elevated to the top of your inbox by Mail's priority messages.

Take total Camera Control.

Touch. Zoom. Click. Quick.

Now you can take the perfect photo or video in record time. Camera Control gives you an easier way to access camera tools quickly. Simply slide your finger to adjust camera functions like exposure or depth of field, and toggle through each lens or use digital zoom to frame your shot just how you like it.

Click to launch the Camera app. Click again to instantly take a photo.

In video mode, click to start recording.

A light press opens controls like Zoom.

New camera system.

Go to great lengths to get the perfect shot.

The versatile new iPhone 16 camera system captures beautiful photos from up close or far away. The two-in-one 48MP Fusion camera lets you take stunning super-high-resolution images, or zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto. The Ultra Wide camera shoots extreme close-up macro photos or wider, more expansive pictures. Altogether, it’s like having four lenses in your pocket. And with spatial capture, you can even take photos and videos in 3D, which you can watch with Apple Vision Pro.

Ultra Wide camera.

Focus on the little things.
And the bigger picture.

The new Ultra-Wide camera with autofocus takes incredibly sharp, detailed macro photos and videos. You can also frame more expansive scenes without taking a step back. And because it has a larger aperture and bigger pixels, it can capture up to 2.6x more light for higher image quality even in low light.

Spatial Capture.

Bring a whole new dimension to your photos and videos.

 

With its realigned cameras, iPhone 16 lets you take magical photos and videos in a whole new way using spatial capture. So you can relive those moments in immersive 3D with Apple Vision Pro.

A18 chip. Hi. IQ.

Meet A18, custom-built for Apple Intelligence and so much more. It jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. And it powers next-level camera features like Photographic Styles and Camera Control. All with exceptional power efficiency to extend battery life.

Even longer battery life. You’ll need to recharge before it will.

iPhone 16 has been designed to make room for a larger battery, which works together with A18 to deliver a big boost in battery life, even with so many new features. So you can game, binge, and rock on and on.

Snap-on a new MagSafe charger for even faster wireless charging up to 25W with a 30W power adapter or higher, enabling up to 50% charge in around 30 minutes.

Up to27 hours playback
on iPhone 16 Plus

Up to22 hours of video playback
on iPhone 16

Action button.

Do more. Wait less.

The Action button on iPhone 16 is a fast track to your favourite feature. Just press and hold to launch the action you want the flashlight, a voice memo, Silent mode, and more. You can also set up Shortcuts to open an app, run a series of tasks, or change actions depending on the time of day or your location. Or use it to take actions in an app, like setting an alarm or even ordering your favourite coffee drink.

iOS 18. Customize. Stylize. Mesmerize.

 

Personalize your Home Screen. Tint your icons with any colour. Rearrange and resize apps and widgets. You can even lock or hide apps to protect sensitive information it’s your call.

Choose your controls. Swap out your Lock Screen controls for ones you love to use more often. Or you can assign a control to the Action button.

Find your favourite shots faster. In the redesigned Photos app, your Collections are automatically organized by topic, like People & Pets.

No signal?
There’s a satellite for that.

The iPhone 16 Pro can link you to a satellite so you can stay in touch or get the help you need even if you don't have cell service or Wi-Fi.

When you're offline, you can use the Messages app to send and receive messages and Tapbacks using the satellite messaging feature. To send texts via SMS or iMessage, your iPhone will assist you in setting up a satellite connection.

You can get assistance for issues like a flat tyre or a dead car battery by using Roadside Assistance via satellite. Even if you're off the grid, your iPhone can enable you to get in touch with a roadside assistance provider who can send help to your specific position.

For two years, free satellite roadside assistance is offered with the iPhone 16 Pro.

Crash Detection When a serious auto accident is detected, Crash Detection combines hardware sensors and advanced motion algorithms to alert emergency contacts and call 911. It can even identify crashes without service.

Features

iPhone 16 Pro Max

Hello Apple Intelligence 

Get the highlights.

The first iPhone was built for Apple Intelligence. Personal, private, powerful.

So fast. So fluid. Get a feel for the all-new Camera Control.

4K 120 fps Dolby Vision.
4 studio-quality mics.
A Pro studio in your pocket.

All-new A18 Pro chip powers unrivalled intelligence. And unprecedented performance.

Take a closer look.

Strength. Beauty. Titanium.

iPhone 16 Pro features a Grade 5 titanium design with a new, refined microblasted finish. Titanium has one of the highest strength-to-weight ratios of any metal, making these models incredibly strong and impressively light. iPhone 16 Pro comes in four stunning colors including the new Desert Titanium.

Internal design improvements including a 100 per cent recycled aluminium thermal substructure and back glass optimizations that further dissipate heat enable up to 20 per cent better-sustained performance than iPhone 15 Pro. So you can do all the things you love like high-intensity gaming for longer.

iPhone 16 Pro Max has largest iPhone display ever.

The thinnest borders on any Apple product

Premium Grade 5 titanium is exceptionally durable

Four striking colours, from Black Titanium to the new Desert Titanium

The 6.3-inch and 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR displays are larger and feel fantastic in the hand thanks to thinner borders made possible by new display technology that allows us to transmit display data under active pixels without distortion.

The iPhone 16 Pro is resistant to dust, water, and splashes. Additionally, it features our most recent Ceramic Shield material, which is twice as durable as any smartphone glass. Let's talk about resilience.

The iPhone 16 Pro & 16 Pro Max is designed with Apple Intelligence in mind, which is a personal intelligence system that facilitates writing, self-expression, and task completion. It provides you with the assurance that nobody else, not even Apple, may access your data thanks to its ground-breaking privacy features.

Boost Your Productivity

Explore new tools that help you write, focus, and communicate.

Writing Tools can summarise a portion of your content with a tap, edit and rewrite portions of it until the tone and words are exactly appropriate. Almost anywhere you write, even third-party programs, you can find them.

To collect audio recordings and transcripts, simply press the record button in the Notes or Phone app. Apple Intelligence summarises your transcripts so you can quickly review the most crucial information.

Time-sensitive communications, such as an invitation with a deadline today or a check-in reminder for your travel this afternoon, are elevated to the top of your inbox by Mail's priority messages.

Great powers come with great privacy.

Apple Intelligence is built with your privacy in mind at all times. It is included via on-device processing into the core of the iPhone. Therefore, even if it hasn't collected your personal information, it is aware of it.

Furthermore, using cutting-edge Private Cloud Compute, Apple Intelligence can process more complicated requests for you while safeguarding your privacy by utilising larger Apple-designed server-based models that operate on Apple silicon.

New 48MP Ultra Wide camera.

iPhone 16 Pro adds a second 48MP camera to the Pro camera system. The new 48MP Ultra Wide camera has a more advanced quad-pixel sensor for super-high-resolution 48MP ProRAW and HEIF photos with autofocus.

So you can capture a mesmerizing new level of detail in macro photos and sweeping, wide-angle shots.

0.5x Ultra Wide

More zoom? Boom. Now you can shoot in 120 mm with the 5x Telephoto camera on both Pro models and get sharper close-ups from farther away. With multiple framing options, it’s like having seven pro lenses in your pocket, everywhere you go.

Choose yourPhotographic Style. Change it up. Change it back.

iPhone's latest generation of Photographic Styles gives you greater creative flexibility than ever before, so you can make every photo even more you. And thanks to advances in our image pipeline, you can now reverse any style, anytime.

A18 Pro chip.
The brains behind Apple Intelligence.

A phenomenally powerful chip, the A18 Pro enables Apple Intelligence with a faster Neural Engine, an improved CPU and GPU, and a big jump in memory bandwidth. It also drives advanced video and photo features like Camera Control, and it delivers our best-ever graphics performance for AAA gaming.

The new 16-core Neural Engine is faster and more efficient, supercharging Apple Intelligence

The new 6-core GPU gives you enhanced graphics performance

New 6-core CPU,
the fastest in smartphone runs complex workloads with less power

Nearly 20% increase in total system memory bandwidth, the highest ever in iPhone, for outstanding performance

Up to 4 more hours
of battery life. Stellar.

iPhone 16 Pro gives you a huge leap in battery life. How? An optimized internal design fits larger batteries, which work together with the A18 Pro chip to deliver incredibly power-efficient performance. Even with so many new capabilities.

Snap on a new MagSafe charger for even faster wireless charging up to 25W with a 30W power adapter or higher, enabling up to 50% charge in around 30 minutes.

Up to33 hours playback on
iPhone 16 Pro Max

Up to27 hours playback on
iPhone 16 Pro

iOS 18 Customize Stylize Mesmerize

 

Personalize your Home Screen. Tint your icons with any color. Rearrange and resize apps and widgets. You can even lock or hide apps to protect sensitive information — it’s your call.

Choose your controls. Swap out your Lock Screen controls for ones you love to use more often. Or you can assign a control to the Action button.

Find your favorite shots faster. In the redesigned Photos app, your Collections are automatically organized by topic, like People & Pets.

No signal?
There’s a satellite for that.

The iPhone 16 Pro can link you to a satellite so you can stay in touch or get the help you need even if you don't have cell service or Wi-Fi.

When you're offline, you can use the Messages app to send and receive messages and Tapbacks using the satellite messaging feature. To send texts via SMS or iMessage, your iPhone will assist you in setting up a satellite connection.

You can get assistance for issues like a flat tyre or a dead car battery by using Roadside Assistance via satellite. Even if you're off the grid, your iPhone can enable you to get in touch with a roadside assistance provider who can send help to your specific position.

For two years, free satellite roadside assistance is offered with the iPhone 16 Pro.

Crash Detection When a serious auto accident is detected, Crash Detection combines hardware sensors and advanced motion algorithms to alert emergency contacts and call 911. It can even identify crashes without service.
